newsitem.title: UK: LME copper, zinc firmer in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper, zinc firmer in late trading.

text.p: Three months copper prices nudged higher in late inter-office trading on Thursday but activity was generally subdued after the choppy activity earlier in the day.
Copper was last quoted at $2,336/40 after a kerb close of $2,318 which was up $13 on the day.

Although three months zinc finished the afternoon kerb at exactly the same price as the previous day's close of $1,460 per tonne, it found renewed buying interest after the close and quoted at $1,465/75.
Prices had found support in the morning around $1,420/30, following Tuesday's dramatic $300 slide from seven-year highs.
Aluminium also firmed in late trading and was quoted at $1,712/15 after a kerb close of $1,701, up $4.
